title: CNA: An AI-Oriented Comprehensive Normalized Assessment for Healthy Status and Application to Optimize RRT Strategies by Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Millions worldwide require Renal Replacement Therapy (RRT) as a treatment essential for survival. However, optimizing RRT strategies via AI is challenging due to heterogeneous patient dynamics, missing data, and the absence of an AI-oriented health assessment criterion. We propose an AI-Oriented Comprehensive Normalized Assessment (CNA) for healthy status and apply it to optimize RRT strategies by using offline reinforcement learning (RL). The key idea of CNA is transforming vital-sign distributions into a standard normal space, enabling a unified, data-driven health-status score defined by deviations from referent intervals, which also provides an AI-oriented criterion to assess strategy quality and supports RL termination. We further design a structured 23-dimensional state representation that integrates 19 indicators with 4 RRT descriptors, and employ matrix decomposition to reconstruct missing vital signs, improving data completeness

translated_title: CNA：一种面向AI的健康状况综合归一化评估方法及其在通过强化学习优化肾脏替代治疗策略中的应用
translated_abstract: 全球有数百万人需要肾脏替代治疗（RRT）作为维持生存的必要治疗手段。然而，由于患者动态的异质性、数据缺失以及缺乏面向AI的健康评估标准，通过AI优化RRT策略极具挑战性。我们提出了一种面向AI的健康状况综合归一化评估方法（CNA），并将其应用于通过离线强化学习（RL）优化RRT策略。CNA的核心思想是将生命体征分布转换到标准正态空间，从而实现一种统一的、数据驱动的健康状态评分，该评分由偏离参考区间的程度来定义，同时也提供了一个面向AI的标准来评估策略质量并支持强化学习的终止。我们进一步设计了一个结构化的23维状态表示，将19个指标与4个RRT描述符相结合，并采用矩阵分解来重建缺失的生命体征，提高了数据完整性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向AI的健康状况综合归一化评估方法CNA，通过将生命体征转换到标准正态空间实现统一的健康状态评分，并结合离线强化学习优化肾脏替代治疗策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CNA, an AI-oriented comprehensive normalized assessment that transforms vital-sign distributions into a standard normal space for unified health-status scoring, and applies it with offline reinforcement learning to optimize renal replacement therapy strategies.
